messages:
ceo_jamie: Quick note: Hosted API streaming + tool-calling v3 is GA as of now. Congrats team! We'll do a staged region rollout and follow up with external comms after verification.

infra_lead: Rollout plan: region-by-region over 36h. /v2 will continue to respond and emit Deprecation headers for 30 days. No API key changes. Will auto-redirect non-custom clients after 14 days.

sdk_eng: SDKs (py/js/go) already map v3 frames back to the v2 shape when api_version=="v2"; raw webhook consumers must adopt the new streaming frame schema. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/toolcall-v3/migrate

support_bot: support-bot: increased temporary burst quota applied to paid tool-calling tenants to reduce migration throttles. Please route customer reports to #support.

infra_lead: Ops note: small canary hiccup in us-east-1 earlier due to header parsing; fixed and redeployed. Monitoring dashboards live for frame-errors and detokenization mismatches.

ceo_jamie: Short exec quote for marketing: "This release makes tool-driven workflows far more reliable and predictable in production." DM marketing-distro if you want longer.

sdk_eng: Reminder: deterministic detokenization in v3 reduces output jitter on retries. Tests/alerts added.

ceo_jamie: Thanks everyone 680
